rows.atomic_requirement: Decision capture with one-line owner reason
rows.source_description: What it is: Every time you make a decision — "I chose this competition over that one," "this essay idea feels right," "this tool is better" — you log it with a one-line reason. How Claire uses it: Before Claire proposes an option, she retrieves similar past decisions from your journal and adapts her recommendation. Implementation: A SQLite table, a form, and a vector search over your notes. That's it. Real, buildable in a weekend. What it achieves: Claire starts making choices that resemble yours.
